features: Per-symbol news query / news result capsules on Terminal cards now always sit on the second line below the symbol/state/sector row.
The filled S-state capsule is slightly enlarged to better match the approved reference while keeping the same gradient style and state text.
Sector/category text is tuned smaller and darker-neutral to better match the approved reference style.
No chart geometry, probability logic, Worker/API behavior, filters, PW mapping, or any other unspecified UI areas are changed in this release.
